svg.title: About
svg.desc: I build full-stack products and ship AI into them. React and Next.js up front, Express or Python and Flask behind them. These days I work as an AI engineer, building agents that reason, use tools and get real work done. Path so far: Codenix, Freelance developer (2024 — Now); Nifty Code, Full-stack developer (2025 — 2026); ProgrammersTech, MERN stack intern (2024); COMSATS Lahore, BS Computer Science (2022 — 2026).
